comments.body: 2026-11-19 re-triage: ai-proposed, fails the third test (a new CLI option). Question for the owner: should Muster offer close-after-turn? Recommendation: yes, as `pane close --after-turn`, held by the daemon.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: A Codex agent asked to finish its turn and close its own pane tried a detached `pane wait --until idle` followed by `pane close`; the pane stayed open, cause unknown. A daemon-held close-on-idle (say `pane close --after-turn`) would let an agent finish its reply and close its pane in one command. New interface, so an idea until the owner takes it up. From tooling feedback a_32FvAUBy1.
title: Close a pane once its agent's turn ends
